planning_notes: The request for 3 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting the three most mathematically and architecturally dense concepts from the available set (VAE Encoder, Reparameterization Trick, VAE Loss Function). To ensure non-redundancy and high difficulty, each target was assigned a distinct pedagogical facet: Theoretical Rationale for the Reparameterization Trick (focusing on gradient flow), Error Diagnosis for the VAE Loss Function (focusing on KL divergence sign errors and scaling), and Boundary Edge Case for the VAE Encoder (focusing on numerical stability in log-variance). This approach leverages the limited concept pool by deepening the assessment into specific, high-level analytical traps rather than surface-level recall.
